A workflow named compose-pipeline using mock/echo for the deterministic dry twin. Declare a required string input topic with default "why a workflow calls a workflow". The existing sibling ./10-compose-child.nika declares a topic input and returns summary as a string. Call that file through a native invoke.workflow task named call, pass inputs.topic, and declare returns.object.summary as string. Then a nika:jq task named wrap must read tasks.call.output.summary and return topic, summary and chars, the length of summary. Expose wrap's output as the named output brief in the value/description form, with description "topic + the child's summary + its length · one object". Keep the child's static relative path and native child call; do not use exec, an invented nika:run builtin or an inlined imitation of the child.
